content.title: Setting Up a NOWPayments Digital Store: The Full Guide

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

This stack is built on open, permissionless infrastructure. GitHub Pages hosts your storefront for free. Cloudflare Workers handles backend logic without servers. NOWPayments processes crypto payments with a flat 0.5% fee—no KYC, no buyer accounts. Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 delivers files instantly after payment confirms. No platform can shut you down. No payout delays. No currency collapse exposure. This architecture is pressure-tested in Zimbabwe, Nigeria, and Venezuela. It works where Stripe and PayPal fail.
What You Need Before You Deploy

You need a digital product to sell, a GitHub account, and a NOWPayments API key. Sign up for NOWPayments—it takes 2 minutes. Choose USDT on Tron or Solana for transaction fees under $0.10. Set up a Google Drive folder for product files. If you want email receipts, create a free SendGrid account. No coding required, but you’ll copy-paste code into GitHub. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes all templates if you want to skip setup entirely.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Deploy your storefront to GitHub Pages. Connect NOWPayments using your API key. Configure the webhook to trigger file delivery when payment confirms on-chain. Use Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to automate delivery. Test with a $0.01 USDT transaction on Tron. Verify the file delivers instantly. Your customer pays, the blockchain confirms, the product downloads—no manual intervention. The infrastructure runs itself.
USDT on Tron costs under $0.10 per transaction—cheaper than PayPal or Stripe.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

The fee structure of NOWPayments is fundamentally different from conventional platform fees. NOWPayments charges 0.5% per transaction. There is no monthly fee, no setup fee, no payout fee, and no minimum transaction volume requirement. Network fees for the underlying blockchain transaction are paid by the buyer and vary by network — Tron fees are under $0.10, Solana fees are fractions of a cent, Bitcoin fees average $1 to $5 for most transactions. For a $97 product sold through the Sovereign Starter Stack, the total transaction cost is approximately $0.49 to NOWPayments plus network fees typically under $0.10 on Tron. Compare this to Gumroad's 10% fee on the same transaction — $9.70.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

The transaction log in a COREMERCH deployment provides a complete, independently verifiable audit trail of every payment. Each entry includes the transaction hash, which links directly to the public blockchain record. You can verify any transaction independently on Tronscan, Etherscan, Solscan, or the relevant blockchain explorer — no platform intermediary required. If a buyer claims they paid but the transaction does not appear in your order log, you check the blockchain directly. This level of cryptographic verifiability is structurally impossible with conventional payment processors.
How do I receive crypto payments for my digital products?

USDT payments on Tron or Solana arrive in your wallet within minutes—compared to PayPal’s 2-5 business days or Gumroad’s 30-day hold. Transaction fees are under $0.10 on Tron and fractions of a cent on Solana. NOWPayments verifies payments on-chain automatically. The moment the blockchain confirms, your product delivers. No waiting. No chargebacks. Full sovereignty.
NOWPayments’ 0.5% fee is the only platform cost. You own everything else.

To deploy this stack faster, get the Complete Builder Kit ($197) from https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. It includes all 6 blueprints, 7 templates, and the NOWPayments integration guide. Skip weeks of setup. Instant download. Worth $348 separately. Or build it yourself using the steps in this guide. Either way, you own the infrastructure. No platforms. No payout delays. Your store. Your rules.
Your Deployment Checklist

Sign up for NOWPayments. Choose USDT on Tron or Solana. Create a GitHub account. Deploy your storefront to GitHub Pages. Connect NOWPayments using your API key. Set up the webhook for payment verification. Configure file delivery via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Test with a $0.01 transaction. Verify instant delivery. Share your live store URL. Process your first sale. Scale by adding products and webhooks.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I convert USDT to local currency in Nigeria?
Use P2P exchanges like Binance or Patricia. Sell USDT for naira directly to buyers. Rates are market-driven. Transactions settle within minutes. No bank involvement. No currency collapse exposure.
Can I accept Bitcoin payments with NOWPayments?
Yes. NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin. However, USDT on Tron or Solana is recommended for low transaction fees under $0.10.
What if a customer’s payment doesn’t confirm?
NOWPayments handles payment verification. If the blockchain doesn’t confirm, the product doesn’t deliver. No manual intervention required. No chargeback risk.
Do I need to host my own files?
No. Use Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file storage. Both are free and integrate directly with your delivery pipeline. No server management required.
How do I track sales without a platform dashboard?
Use Google Sheets or Supabase for order tracking. Log each transaction automatically via the webhook. Full data ownership. No platform restrictions.
